notes: Raw Jain is descriptive when source demand is asymmetric.
Sparse-only Jain excludes the configured Heavy source.
Fire/cycle is not measured memory bandwidth.
Service gaps are observed scheduler intervals, not a starvation bound.

unavailable.application_slowdown: No application or calibrated CXL system harness is present.
unavailable.completed_memory_bandwidth: No calibrated CXL platform or completed-byte measurement is present.
unavailable.dynamic_weighted_cgof_entitlement: RTL endpoints do not expose the dynamic per-window class trajectory needed to reconstruct CGOF (2:1) entitlements.
unavailable.finite_heavy_completion: RTL endpoints have no finite Heavy workload, burst ID, or burst completion trace.
unavailable.joint_backlog_quota_compliance: RTL endpoints expose per-source backlog summaries, not a joint per-cycle all-source backlog trace.
unavailable.memory_response_latency: Generation-to-fire is scheduler waiting, not an issue-to-response CXL measurement.
